text: Done in e9a3d54 and 18db12f, merged as af6d696 (17 November 2026). `python3 scripts/demo-instance.py up` builds the image, starts PostgreSQL and the service, and seeds two labs, three datasets and four people; `down --volumes` removes everything. scripts/check-demo-instance.sh passed on the merged tree with the current interpreter. Limits: the first start needs Java 21 and sbt; database passwords reach the containers as environment variables; the organization preview is accepted without review; sign-in is a printed token; the new CI job has not run on a hosted runner.
